gate_rule: 2-of-3: CALL when >=2 instruments clear 0.95 the same way and none contradicts by >0.20 the other way; p_gate = median

instruments.model_note: P(champion) proportional to exp(rating/tau), tau=8 rating points (stated prior, not fitted); hosts South Africa get +3 rating home bonus (stated prior)

quality_flags: 13 months to resolution - the engine's instruments are at their weakest this far out; expect WATCH on anything sharp.
Instruments openly disagree on England: the market makes them 3rd favourite (7.0) while ICC ratings rank them 8th. That divergence is the product, not a bug.
Bookmaker odds snapshot is undated; Manifold is thin (~1.8k traded). Market instrument is low-grade and treated as such.
Model is championship-share by rating, not a tournament simulation - format (14 teams, SA/Zim/Namibia, Oct-Nov 2027) not yet modeled.

Market instrument prices only 4 teams, so its probability for any wider set (e.g. 'top 8') is a FLOOR, not an estimate - the true market number is higher. Gate verdicts are unaffected (floor only makes the gate more conservative).

questions.q: Winner in {India, Australia, South Africa, England}

rules: Winner = team awarded the trophy per ICC official result, including a final decided by DLS or a super over
Shared trophy (final abandoned with no reserve-day result): every 'X wins' question resolves YES for each co-champion; set-membership questions resolve YES if any co-champion is in the set
'Winner from current ICC top 8' resolves against the eight teams named in the question's entity list at freeze (2026-10-22 ratings), not the ratings at tournament time
Tournament cancelled or not completed with no trophy awarded = VOID, logged and excluded from scoring
